capabilities: convert LaTeX equations from ChatGPT answers to Obsidian-compatible Markdown
run the conversion via a command
trigger conversion from a sidebar button
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX editor or renderer; it only rewrites LaTeX from ChatGPT replies into Obsidian-compatible Markdown.
extras: README is in Chinese. It warns that users must disable the 'Auto convert HTML' editor setting or paste ChatGPT answers as plain text.
motivation: The README says the goal is to let users conveniently use math formulas in Obsidian notes to improve learning efficiency and research quality.
problem: LaTeX pasted from ChatGPT uses delimiters Obsidian does not render correctly, so users must clean up formulas by hand.
summary: Converts LaTeX equations in ChatGPT answers into Markdown that Obsidian can recognize and render.
